name: priority-audio-switch
title: Priority Audio Switch
description: Switch audio input and output devices automatically by priority.
author: Neideltern

commands.name: set-output-device
commands.title: Output Device
commands.subtitle: Priority Audio Switch
commands.description: Choose the output device, rank devices, and pin or mute their volume.

commands.name: set-input-device
commands.title: Input Device
commands.subtitle: Priority Audio Switch
commands.description: Choose the input device, rank devices, and pin or mute their volume.

commands.name: auto-switch
commands.title: Enable Auto Switch
commands.subtitle: Priority Audio Switch
commands.description: Switches input and output devices by priority when a device connects or disconnects, keeps a manual choice until the next change, and restores pinned volumes. Runs in the background.

commands.name: cycle-output-device
commands.title: Cycle Output Device
commands.subtitle: Priority Audio Switch
commands.description: Switches to the next output device that has a priority or Switch on Connect. Assign a hotkey to it.

commands.name: cycle-input-device
commands.title: Cycle Input Device
commands.subtitle: Priority Audio Switch
commands.description: Switches to the next input device that has a priority or Switch on Connect. Assign a hotkey to it.

preferences.name: systemOutput
preferences.title: System Sounds
preferences.description: When you select an output device, also use it for alerts and sound effects.
preferences.label: Play system sounds through the selected output
